    Project

    Public repositories of the OCTPRISM organization.

    • CivilSimulator

      AboutA playable civilization game and a hands-on society simulation sandbox. You choose a world, walk a 3D scene, talk with nearby characters, and invite friends into the same room. The labs run controllable experiments on population, markets, public opinion, and weather, and a local language model can drive the narrative. The current release is Tech Preview v0.4.0 and is invite-only.

    • VibeML

      AboutA natural-language loop from data preparation through to a deployable model. It covers text classification, image classification, visual question answering, reinforcement learning, and instruction tuning. Each round is checked for significance: when the gain stays inside the noise, the system reports no improvement instead of a higher score. It is built for small samples and Chinese text, and it can run entirely on a local machine.

      HighlightThe conversation layer is multi-agent. It carries a task from clarification through data, model choice, configuration, training, and a report. If a tool call fails, the same flow falls back to a deterministic state machine.
